_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 37: 28-31 December 2025. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He reads a news item that there is no terrorist attack or security threat in mind for New Year's Eve, that the NYPD and the city want to keep it that way, and that Times Square is one of the largest and most complex public safety operations in the world.
mentions.quote: New York City locked
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: a read-aloud news report.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He reads that while Times Square gets the confetti, New York's real power shift is happening underground, with the mayor elect sworn in just before midnight on January 1st inside the abandoned old city hall subway station, a 1904 landmark.
mentions.quote: New York's real power shift is happening underground
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: a report of a scheduled event.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a. Worth keeping because underground is a word he has been using prophetically for months.

mentions.claim_text: He says everything the Lord has told them was coming concerning 2026, and that what the Lord said today shook him, because he talked about the plague.
mentions.quote: He talked about the plague. He talked about the plague
mentions.falsify_match: An epidemic. The plague has now been placed in 2026, 2027 and 2028 in different tellings.
mentions.falsify_miss: No epidemic. What was said today is not restated here.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a red dawn experience while America is preoccupied with herself, and says that if you go back to the prophetic words in 2023 and 2024 he saw China waiting to infiltrate and take Taiwan while America is preoccupied with what is going on inside her.
mentions.quote: a red dawn experience as America's preoccupied with herself
mentions.falsify_match: A Chinese move on Taiwan during a period of American domestic crisis.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such move. This is the first passage that gives red dawn any content.

mentions.claim_text: He says it was taken within three days and he saw a surrendering as China took over, then saw Israel being afflicted and cites Ezekiel 38 and 39, all happening quickly while America was out because of so much drama coming into America.
mentions.quote: taken within three days. I saw a surrendering as China took over
mentions.falsify_match: Taiwan falling in roughly three days.
mentions.falsify_miss: No invasion, or a long one. Note this says three days where the existing claim says two.

mentions.claim_text: He thanks God for what he has done and says that as they go into this next three years the Lord keeps talking about 2028, and gives thanks for the shaking to the waking.
mentions.quote: I thank you, Father, for the shaking to the waking
mentions.falsify_match: Shakings followed by a religious awakening by 2028.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. The phrase makes the shaking the mechanism of the awakening, so hardship confirms it.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that they humble themselves, that God is good and his mercy endures through 2025 and in 2026 and 2027 and 2028, and declares that America will remain.
mentions.quote: America will remain
mentions.falsify_match: The nation continues to exist, which is close to certain.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. As near to unlosable as anything in the corpus.

mentions.claim_text: He calls in healings and manifestations of glory over each of them, praying that they will not go into 2026 sick in body at all with flu, stomach bugs or heart disease.
mentions.quote: they'll not go into 2026 sick in body at all
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable in practice: no audience-wide health outcome is measurable, and any illness is attributed to the individual rather than the prayer.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He refers back to the 11th of December and to corruption in Minnesota, the uncovering of mismanagement of money and money laundering, and darkness there.
mentions.quote: all the corruption in Minnesota and the uncovering of all that darkness
mentions.falsify_match: A Minnesota fraud or money laundering case becoming public.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The 11 December telling is in this corpus and can be read directly.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees corruption but that out of the corruption springs forth a hive of big black and yellow bumblebees coming up around her concerning Minnesota, and asks whether she is even in Minnesota because he does not know why he is seeing it.
mentions.quote: out of the corruption, a spring forth a hive of bumblebees
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable as given: he says outright he does not know what the image means or who she is.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says what the Lord showed them on December the 11th is coming to pass as of yesterday, and that prophetic accuracy is important.
mentions.quote: Prophetic accuracy is important
mentions.falsify_match: The 11 December video says what he says it says, and the December news matches. Both halves are checkable.
mentions.falsify_miss: Either half fails.

mentions.claim_text: He plays a political statement about Minnesota having been listed as the best state, still being in crisis, and a federal programme of paid family medical leave enhancing the workforce and families.
mentions.quote: We were listed as the best state. We're still in crisis
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: someone else's words, played as evidence.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says things will make you go horizontal looking all around but that you must stay vertical in 2026 because great distractions will be on the news, and says he saw the major news networks having lost their relevance.
mentions.quote: you must stay vertical in 2026 for great distractions will be on the news
mentions.falsify_match: Continued decline of the legacy networks, which is a decade-old trend.
mentions.falsify_miss: They recover. The distraction half cannot miss.

mentions.claim_text: He says they have a plan to shut down the First Amendment so people cannot say what they want, that the Lord was warning about it especially concerning 2028, and that it will try to come out in 2026 but be really strong in 2028.
mentions.quote: shut down the First Amendment so that people won't be able to say
mentions.falsify_match: Federal action restricting speech.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Who they are is not specified.

mentions.claim_text: He asks the Holy Spirit to help him not misquote it, then reports being told that New York has been weighed in the balance and found lacking.
mentions.quote: You have been weighed in the balance and you found lacking
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a verdict, not an event. The Daniel 5 wording implies judgment follows.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says the figure would be someone dark like Harry Potter in the days ahead with a black cloak around him, that he saw the number seven beside him, and then saw 2026 set in stone.
mentions.quote: There was a black cloak around him. And I saw the number seven
mentions.falsify_match: An identifiable figure emerging in 2026 matching the description.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Set in stone is the strongest certainty language he uses, attached to the least specific content.

mentions.claim_text: He says the tent revivals are coming back and the well of revival is stirring up within, names Jack Coe, and reports being told I am going to do it again, warn them, as one last push.
mentions.quote: I see the tent revivals are coming back again
mentions.falsify_match: A visible return of tent revival meetings.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. No date is attached.

mentions.claim_text: He says New York is the theme of the night of what the Lord showed him, asks for New York to be put on the background, and tells listeners to pray over New Year's Eve over every location wherever they are.
mentions.quote: It's the theme of the night of what the Lord showed me
mentions.falsify_match: An incident at a New Year's Eve gathering.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, credited to the prayer. This is the second year running the same prayer target.

mentions.claim_text: He tells listeners to take dominion over their area and pray a hedge of protection around their own town and around Queensland and any major city represented, and says Queensland is highlighted to him right now.
mentions.quote: Queensland. It's highlighted to me right
mentions.falsify_match: An incident in Queensland.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. A named place with no act and no date, the same shape as atlanta-airport-hedge.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that the Lord be magnified in the prosperity of his servant, that those who favour his righteous cause shout for joy and be glad, and gives thanks that it is going to happen.
mentions.quote: In the prosperity of his servant, let the Lord be magnified
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a scriptural warrant for the prosperity claims.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether the listener knows him and more importantly whether he knows them, whether they would spend eternity with him if they died tonight, and says it is not their grandmother's religion or their mother's but theirs, since nobody else will bring them to heaven.
mentions.quote: It's not your grandma's religion. It's not your mama's. It's you
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He notes the escalation in the Middle East and says the Lord warned them again about a surprise attack at night, in the middle of the night, worse than October 7th.
mentions.quote: a surprise attack at night in the middle of the night worse than October 7th
mentions.falsify_match: A night attack on Israel exceeding 7 October 2023.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Third telling since 22 November, still with no date attached.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a seven with a lighter colour in the middle, says he wondered why he was seeing the number seven concerning the little boy, and that he did not know the boy would be the seventh.
mentions.quote: why am I seeing the number seven concerning this little boy?
mentions.falsify_match: The boy being the seventh of something, which he presents as already confirmed.
mentions.falsify_miss: He did not know what the seven meant until afterwards, which is the pattern worth tracking: the number is given first and the referent found later.

mentions.claim_text: He prays for wealth over America as one last push and one last call, that 2026 will be a year of supernatural increase over the body of Christ, and thanks God for a window of opportunity to pay off debt.
mentions.quote: 2026 will be a year of supernatural increase over the body of Christ
mentions.falsify_match: Reported financial windfalls among the audience.
mentions.falsify_miss: None reported. Supernatural increase has no threshold.

mentions.claim_text: He says that for 2026 there will be a supernatural harvest time, that precious metals will go higher than they have ever been before and crypto will shoot up like a rocket, and thanks God that inflation is being dealt with.
mentions.quote: precious metals will go up higher than they've ever been before
mentions.falsify_match: Gold or silver at all-time highs in 2026 and a sharp crypto rally.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. This one is measurable to the dollar, which is rare here.

mentions.claim_text: He reports being told the economy is in trouble and that the American economy is a catfish, that this will be seen more in 2026, and that they must pray over the economy to turn around and for the Supreme Court judges to decide rightly.
mentions.quote: Your economy in America is a catfish
mentions.falsify_match: Economic figures revealed as overstated during 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: They hold up. Catfish is his own image for something presented as better than it is.

mentions.claim_text: He recounts asking whether something was wrong and being asked in return whether he or the Lord is in control, answering the Lord, then asking when to give it and being told to do it on the 27th, so he told Dana they were holding off.
mentions.quote: I want you to do it on the 27th
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable from outside: an internal instruction about release timing.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says he is told go here, do not go there, do not go to that platform, follow my voice, and that when he asked about one platform he was told that is where prophets go to die.
mentions.quote: That's where prophets go to die
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is a reason given for declining platforms where the claims would face harder questions.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says things are going to accelerate and are about to accelerate, points at particular families, and says he sees the number 2026.
mentions.quote: Things are about to accelerate. I see 2026
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: acceleration with no measure, said since 2023.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He asks for highlights, asking what the massive ugly lion he kept seeing in England represents, why he is seeing it, and what it has to do with Oxford.
mentions.quote: What was that ugly lion in England? What does it have to do with Oxford?
mentions.falsify_match: Something in England or at Oxford that fits.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing. He is asking what it means rather than saying, so there is no claim yet, only an image.
